Chapter 10: The Journey Forward—Embracing Change and Uncertainty.
As we reach these final letters, you can almost feel a gentle shift. The father’s eyes turn toward the future. It’s a place that’s equal parts promise and uncertainty. And in his words, there’s this mix of hope, honesty, and a little bit of humility—because, let’s face it, none of us can truly predict what’s waiting around the next corner.
He knows that Su Yen will face her own challenges, just like he did. He remembers back to when he first left home—how the world felt impossibly big and unpredictable. Maybe you’ve felt that way too? There were times he was scared, times he wondered if he was even ready. But here’s the thing: over the years, he realized that change—while it can shake you up—is actually where real growth begins.
He shares a story about a friend at work. After decades in the same job, this friend decided to start over in a completely different field. Can you imagine? Everything familiar was suddenly gone. There were setbacks, doubts, and days that felt impossibly hard. But you know what else showed up? New friendships. New skills. A sense of purpose that made every struggle feel worth it. That leap into the unknown—that’s what brought life back into focus.
The father gently encourages Su Yen—and maybe, in a way, he’s encouraging all of us—to stay open. Try new things. Trust your gut, even when it’s scary. Most people stick to what they know, but real growth? That’s out past the edge of your comfort zone. He reassures her: it’s okay to be afraid. It’s okay to make mistakes, or to change your mind along the way.
And then he talks about gratitude. Even when life feels uncertain, there’s always something to be thankful for—a kind word, a lesson that lands just when you need it, a simple moment of beauty. He hopes Su Yen will carry that sense of thankfulness with her, letting it guide her when things get foggy or tough.
What he’s really offering, as these letters come to a close, is a vision of life that’s honest but hopeful. Change is part of the journey. There will be challenges, and there will absolutely be moments of doubt. But there’s also love—and the knowledge that every twist and turn can help us grow, connect, and find meaning along the way.
